description: This file is a shell script used for platform-specific upgrade procedures in an OpenWRT-based firmware environment. It defines functions for checking image validity and performing upgrades, with specific handling for particular device boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Function to check the image, always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process based on device board type, setting environment variables and calling the default upgrade function.
